stories.headline: Maya Runs First 5K, Then Tacos
stories.article: Maya finished her first 5K at Lady Bird Lake. She went straight to breakfast tacos.

stories.headline: Maya Signs Up For Encore Race
stories.article: Maya signed up for her next race.

panels.scene: Outdoor trail by Lady Bird Lake, Maya just crossing a finish line with arms raised, tired but happy expression, wide shot with lake in background
panels.caption: First 5K finished at Lady Bird Lake.

panels.scene: Maya sitting at an outdoor table with a plate of breakfast tacos in front of her, eating happily, close-up angle
panels.caption: Breakfast tacos = perfect finish line.

panels.scene: Maya on couch at home holding her phone to sign up, focused and excited expression, medium shot
panels.caption: The running bug has bitten.

panels.scene: Maya standing in living room doing a little happy dance with phone in hand, cheerful expression, wide shot
panels.caption: Next race loading.
